leadText: Volume 2: Legendary Pokémon is the second volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and also the second of three volumes in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Mato.
plainText:
Volume 2: Legendary Pokémon is the second volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and also the second of three volumes in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Mato. 

==Blurb==
Red's Pokémon training journey is full of exciting challenges... Join Red as he competes with his rival Blue, travels through the dangerous Safari Zone, battles gym leaders for badges, and discovers the secret of a mysterious Eevee!

And watch out for Team Rocket, Red... They're hunting you!

Chapter 21 - Long Live the Nidoking!
Chapter 22 - A Hollow Victreebel
Chapter 23 - Make Way For Magmar!
Chapter 24 - What a Dragonite

Chapter 27 - Kalling Kadabra

Red's "Aero" in PS026.

===Evolutions===
The following Pokémon evolve:
Red's "Saur" evolves into in PS015.
Blue's evolves into in PS018.
Blue's evolves into sometime between PS018 and PS027.

==Gym battles==
Red obtains the Badges from the following Gym Leaders:
Erika in PS020
Blaine in PS026

==Character summary==
This is Red's Pokédex information and party at the end of this volume.

===Red's Pokédex===
Gym Badges: 4
Pokémon seen: 104
Pokémon owned: 46

==Trivia==

The map of Red's journey shows him take an underground path not in the games. He may have found it in the Rock Tunnel based on his trajectory suddenly changing once he reaches said location.

===Errors===
====VIZ Media second edition====
In the overview of 's party at the end of the book, Snor's nickname is mistakenly listed as "Lax". This also happens in the next volume.
The About the Author section states that Mato was born in while she was, in fact, born in .
